summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing the thirty-day election period for the discontinuation of its Level II Sponsored Brazilian Depositary Receipt program (B3: INBR32), under which each BDR represents one Class A ordinary share. The Selection Period runs September 17 to October 16, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Brasilia time; holders may elect receipt of Class A shares (INTR), Level I Unsponsored BDRs (INBR34), or automatic Sales Facility absent an election. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium was stated.
